task_title: Implement operational execution-grant issuer and scoped TRACE client

items_fixed: 1. token_verifier.py now delegates all cryptographic and revoked/disabled/account-error verification to the pinned firebase-admin SDK's auth.verify_id_token(check_revoked=True), authenticated via Application Default Credentials on the isolated issuer host. The custom OAuth JWT-bearer account-lookup implementation and its downloadable service-account-key requirement are removed entirely.

2. Credential/signing-key input handling (secure_io.read_private_file_strict: symlink/ownership/mode-0600 enforcement) and fully redacted CLI error responses (request_execution_grant.py post_json never echoes remote response bodies) were already hardened in the prior generation and are preserved and re-verified.

3. docs/operations/execution-grant-issuer.md Section 9 replaced with the official v2 accounts/mfaSignIn:finalize endpoint (mfaEnrollmentId + totpVerificationInfo.verificationCode), separates gcloud ADC login from genuine Identity Platform user MFA acquisition, and removes password/pending-credential/idToken from argv or terminal output (stdin/private-file only, umask 0177, no echo-then-chmod window).

4. service.py get_liveness()/get_readiness() were already split (readiness exercises real dependencies and returns 503 on failure, independent of trivial liveness); readiness now exercises the real ADC dependency via IdentityPlatformTokenVerifier.check_identity_platform_readiness().

5. scripts/test_request_execution_grant.py::test_end_to_end_qualified_chain no longer fabricates a shell stub; it bootstraps the real scripts/ai_status.py module against an isolated status root and dispatches to the actual production command_show / command_execution_grant_submit implementations, then reloads state fresh from disk to prove durable persistence of the granted execution_authorization and consumed-nonce ledger.

6. docs/operations/execution-grant-issuer.md Section 6.3 and deploy/execution-grant-issuer/README.md now document the qualified current-host promote_supervisor_runtime.py invocation with explicit --repo, --status-root, --authority-env-file (public-trust-only verifier map), --discover-only before --promote.

criterion_1.statement: Read and implement complete immutable SA/SD. Verify fresh genuine Identity Platform user MFA, explicit operator UID allowlist, separate Ed25519 signer, actor/task/policy-bound single-use challenge, no client-selected policy substitutions. No fixture or ADC treated as real MFA.
criterion_1.evidence: Implemented IdentityPlatformTokenVerifier delegating all cryptographic verification and revoked/disabled-account denial to the pinned firebase-admin SDK's auth.verify_id_token(check_revoked=True) (Application Default Credentials, no downloadable service-account key), layered with MFA second-factor claim verification, operator UID allowlist enforcement, tenant checking, and ChallengeStore's actor/task/generation/policy-bound atomic single-use consumption.

criterion_2.statement: Provide deployable isolated tooling issuer and TRACE-only client through existing qualified canonical show, verifier and grant submission. No new TaskStore writer or product route. Reject S5 and changed canonical bindings. Complete CI-wired cryptographic, malformed input, replay/race, expiry, redaction and isolated full-chain tests with terminal outputs.
criterion_2.evidence: Implemented ExecutionGrantIssuerService, request_execution_grant.py, systemd unit, and wired unittest test suites into scripts/run-acceptance.sh. Passed 49 comprehensive tests (40 in test_issuer.py, 9 in test_request_execution_grant.py) covering real firebase-admin SDK malformed-token rejection, SDK-reported revoked/disabled/expired/invalid/certificate-fetch-failure denial, domain policy (allowlist, tenant, MFA, staleness), fail-closed readiness against the real ADC dependency (separate from trivial liveness), race condition, actor/task/generation/policy substitution, immutable TRACE scope, empty trust rejection, symlink clobber prevention, S5 pause, and a real isolated qualified TaskStore show/submit/reload chain (not a shell stub).

criterion_3.statement: Publish exact source/checksum/test evidence, operations documentation, and isolation/reauthentication guides. Independent exact-head review, required CI, and PR merge are completed during handoff and integration. Source-only scope: does not mint live credentials, assert MFA or deploy hosted product workloads.
criterion_3.evidence: Documented full operational runbook in docs/operations/execution-grant-issuer.md and deploy/execution-grant-issuer/README.md, including the official v2 MFA finalize endpoint, ADC provisioning, and the qualified promote_supervisor_runtime.py invocation. Manifest and exact source checksums updated for all 18 artifacts (adds secure_io.py). Terminal test evidence recorded for 49/49 passing tests across issuer and CLI suites. No live credentials or synthetic live trust keys committed.

test_execution_summary.dependency_python: checkout-scoped venv with deploy/execution-grant-issuer/requirements.txt installed (cryptography==41.0.7, PyJWT==2.7.0, requests==2.31.0, firebase-admin==6.5.0)
